ruleset.name: jpinpoint-nextgen-rules
ruleset.description: jPinpoint "nextgen" rule set: new Kotlin remoting rules using PMD 7.28.0 type-resolution XPath functions (pmd-kotlin:typeIs, pmd-kotlin:matchesSig). These rules REQUIRE a PMD version that supports those features and therefore are NOT included in the standard jpinpoint-kotlin-rules.xml, to keep that file working on older PMD versions. See the "Nextgen rules" section in the README for details. (jpinpoint-rules)

rule.name: AvoidExcessiveClassloadingWithSaajSoap
rule.message: Avoid excessive class loading with SAAJ SOAP messaging, use alternative Axiom, or system properties.
rule.description: Problem: SAAJ uses DOM to load the XML document in memory, which uses a TransformerFactory. The implementation class of it is loaded on every call that causes lock contention under load. This means long response times. Solution: If possible, use Axiom SOAP messaging which uses the faster StAX. If you have/want to stick to SAAJ, set the proper system properties to prevent the excessive class loading. Note: Axiom (2.0) is available again in Spring web services, since version 4.1. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: (: Constructor call to SaajSoapMessageFactory without TransformerFactory system property fix :) //PostfixUnaryExpression[ pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('org.springframework.ws.soap.saaj.SaajSoapMessageFactory#<init>(*)') and not(ancestor::ClassBody//PostfixUnaryExpression[ PrimaryExpression/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier[@Text='System'] and PostfixUnarySuffix/NavigationSuffix/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier[@Text='setProperty'] and .//T-LineStrText[@Text='javax.xml.transform.TransformerFactory'] ]) ] , (: Class-level property with explicit SaajSoapMessageFactory type (no constructor call, that is caught above). (: isWithin pattern :) pmd-kotlin:isWithin('function-body'/'lambda') does not exist in released PMD (7.28.0) - it is from a proposed/experimental future API. Replaced here with a plain ancestor:: check instead, since PropertyDeclaration is used for class-level properties, local variables and lambda-local variables alike; only the ancestor axis distinguishes a class-level declaration from a local one. If/when isWithin() is actually released, search for "(: isWithin pattern :)" to find and simplify all occurrences of this idiom. :) //PropertyDeclaration[ not(ancestor::FunctionBody or ancestor::LambdaLiteral) and pmd-kotlin:typeIs('org.springframework.ws.soap.saaj.SaajSoapMessageFactory') and not(.//PostfixUnaryExpression[pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('org.springframework.ws.soap.saaj.SaajSoapMessageFactory#<init>(*)')]) and not(ancestor::ClassBody//PostfixUnaryExpression[ PrimaryExpression/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier[@Text='System'] and PostfixUnarySuffix/NavigationSuffix/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier[@Text='setProperty'] and .//T-LineStrText[@Text='javax.xml.transform.TransformerFactory'] ]) ]

rule.name: AvoidXMLGregorianCalendar
rule.message: XMLGregorianCalendar is used. It is slow in JAXB.
rule.description: Problem: XMLGregorianCalendar is a large object involving substantial processing. It is created with the poorly performing DatatypeFactory. Solution: Add a converter for alternative date handling with java.time. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AvoidObjectMapperAsField
rule.message: Avoid ObjectMapper as field, use ObjectReader or ObjectWriter instead.
rule.description: Problem: Configuring an ObjectMapper is not thread-safe. Solution: Create ObjectReaders and ObjectWriters from ObjectMapper and only share those as a property, since they are immutable and therefore thread-safe. Exception: convertValue is not provided by ObjectReader/ObjectWriter; suppress the rule in that case. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: ObjectMapperCreatedForEachMethodCall
rule.message: An ObjectMapper or JsonMapper is created for each method call, which is expensive.
rule.description: Problem: Jackson ObjectMapper/JsonMapper creation is expensive because it does much class loading. Solution: Since ObjectMapper/JsonMapper objects are thread-safe after configuration in one thread, they can be shared afterward between requests and reused. Reuse created instances from a companion object or top-level val. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PostfixUnaryExpression[ (pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper#<init>(*)') or pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.json.JsonMapper#builder(*)') or pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.cfg.MapperBuilder#build()')) and (: isWithin pattern :) (ancestor::FunctionBody or ancestor::LambdaLiteral) ]

rule.name: GsonCreatedForEachMethodCall
rule.message: A Gson object is created for each method call, which is expensive.
rule.description: Problem: Gson creation is relatively expensive. Solution: Since Gson objects are thread-safe after creation, they can be shared between threads. Reuse created instances from a companion object or top-level val. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: BufferingClientHttpRequestFactoryIsMemoryGreedy
rule.message: BufferingClientHttpRequestFactory buffers entire response bodies in memory and is memory greedy.
rule.description: Problem: BufferingClientHttpRequestFactory buffers the entire response body in memory, which is memory greedy and can cause OutOfMemoryError for large responses. Solution: Avoid using BufferingClientHttpRequestFactory. If you need to read the response body multiple times, prefer streaming approaches. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PostfixUnaryExpression[pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('org.springframework.http.client.BufferingClientHttpRequestFactory#<init>(*)')]

rule.name: AvoidHttpHostOneArgumentConstructor
rule.message: HttpHost with only hostname uses default port, which may be confusing or incorrect.
rule.description: Problem: Creating an HttpHost with only a hostname uses a default port (-1), which can lead to confusing behaviour. Solution: Always specify the port and protocol explicitly. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PostfixUnaryExpression[pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('org.apache.http.HttpHost#<init>(java.lang.String)')]

rule.name: AvoidJAXBUtil
rule.message: JAXB utility class recreates JAXBContext for each call, which is expensive.
rule.description: Problem: The JAXB utility class (javax.xml.bind.JAXB / jakarta.xml.bind.JAXB) recreates a JAXBContext on each call, which is CPU-intensive due to class scanning. Solution: Create and cache a JAXBContext instance and reuse it. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PostfixUnaryExpression[pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('javax.xml.bind.JAXB#_(*)')] | //PostfixUnaryExpression[pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('jakarta.xml.bind.JAXB#_(*)')]

rule.name: JAXBContextCreatedForEachMethodCall
rule.message: JAXBContext is created for each method call, which is expensive.
rule.description: Problem: JAXBContext creation is expensive: it scans classpath for JAXB-annotated classes. Solution: Create and cache the JAXBContext once (e.g. in a companion object or lazy property) and reuse it. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PostfixUnaryExpression[ (pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('javax.xml.bind.JAXBContext#newInstance(*)') or pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('jakarta.xml.bind.JAXBContext#newInstance(*)')) (: isWithin pattern :) and (ancestor::FunctionBody or ancestor::LambdaLiteral) and not(ancestor::PropertyDelegate) and not(ancestor::FunctionDeclaration[ pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('PostConstruct') or pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('javax.annotation.PostConstruct') or pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct') ]) ]

rule.name: AvoidReactorDebugOverhead
rule.message: Do not use Reactor debugging in production, it has much overhead.
rule.description: Problem: For troubleshooting Reactor, Blockhound can be used. It needs proper stack traces which can be achieved by Hooks.onOperatorDebug(). This can have much CPU overhead. Solution: Remove Hooks.onOperatorDebug() when not debugging. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PostfixUnaryExpression[pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('reactor.core.publisher.Hooks#onOperatorDebug()')]

rule.name: AvoidRecreatingHttpClient
rule.message: An HttpClient is created inside a method. Create and reuse it as a shared field instead.
rule.description: Problem: Apache HttpClient with its connection pool and timeouts should be setup once and then used for many requests. It is quite expensive to create and can only provide the benefits of pooling when reused. Solution: Create the HttpClient once and store it in a shared field (companion object or injected bean). (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PostfixUnaryExpression[ (pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('org.apache.http.impl.client.HttpClientBuilder#create(*)') or pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('org.apache.http.impl.client.HttpClients#custom(*)') or pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('org.apache.http.impl.nio.client.HttpAsyncClientBuilder#create(*)')) (: isWithin pattern :) and (ancestor::FunctionBody or ancestor::LambdaLiteral) and not(ancestor::PropertyDelegate) ]

rule.name: AvoidLeakingRetryEventConsumers
rule.message: Avoid registering retry event consumers inside methods; they leak lambda objects on each call.
rule.description: Problem: Calling getEventPublisher().onRetry/onError on a class-field Retry inside a method body adds a new lambda consumer on every method call, causing a memory leak. Solution: Register event consumers once in an init block or constructor. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: RetryCanCauseOverload
rule.message: Be careful with retrying: multiple retry locations in a call chain can cause overload.
rule.description: Problem: Multiple Retry locations in a call chain multiply the number of calls and may cause overload during recovery. Solution: Have the retry mechanism in one location in the chain only, recommended closest to the user. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AvoidModifyingObjectMapper
rule.message: ObjectMapper is configured/modified, only initialize it right after construction.
rule.description: Problem: ObjectMapper is thread-safe only after configuration; modifying it later is not thread-safe. Solution: Configure it during initialization only, then reuse it immutably. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PostfixUnaryExpression[ PostfixUnarySuffix/NavigationSuffix[ matches(SimpleIdentifier/*/@Text, '^(configure|set|register|find|disable|enable|activateDefaultTyping|deactivateDefaultTyping|add|clear).*') ] and PostfixUnarySuffix/CallSuffix and (: isWithin pattern :) ancestor::FunctionBody and not(ancestor::AnonymousInitializer) and PrimaryExpression/SimpleIdentifier/T-Identifier/@Text = ancestor::ClassBody[1]//PropertyDeclaration[ (: isWithin pattern :) not(ancestor::FunctionBody or ancestor::LambdaLiteral) and pmd-kotlin:typeIs('com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper') ]/VariableDeclaration/@Identifier ]

rule.name: AvoidDeprecatedHttpConnectors
rule.message: Avoid the use of deprecated/thread-unsafe HTTP connectors
rule.description: Problem: Several HTTP client connection managers are thread-unsafe or deprecated. Solution: upgrade to modern Apache HttpClient APIs and use supported pooling clients. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ImportHeader[ starts-with(@Name, 'org.apache.commons.httpclient') or starts-with(@Name, 'org.apache.http.conn.ClientConnectionManager') or starts-with(@Name, 'org.apache.http.impl.conn.PoolingClientConnectionManager') or starts-with(@Name, 'org.apache.http.impl.conn.tsccm.ThreadSafeClientConnManager') or starts-with(@Name, 'org.apache.http.impl.conn.SingleClientConnManager') or starts-with(@Name, 'org.apache.http.impl.client.DefaultHttpClient') or starts-with(@Name, 'org.apache.http.impl.client.SystemDefaultHttpClient') ]

rule.example: import org.apache.commons.httpclient.HttpClient // bad import org.apache.hc.client5.http.classic.HttpClient // good

rule.name: DefaultFeignClientWithoutTLSConnectionReuse
rule.message: Default Feign client is used with (mutual) TLS. This is HttpURLConnection that creates a new connection for each call with TLS overhead.
rule.description: Problem: the default http client of Feign is java.net.HttpURLConnection and does not pool connections when using mTLS. Solution: switch to a Feign client that supports HTTP connection pooling with TLS reuse, such as OkHttp-backed Feign. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AvoidHardcodedConnectionConfig
rule.message: Avoid hardcoded connection configuration.
rule.description: Problem: configuring connection settings like timeouts and pool sizes in code makes them difficult to manage and tune. Solution: externalize these values to configuration or use richer types such as Duration. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PropertyDeclaration[ (: isWithin pattern :) not(ancestor::FunctionBody or ancestor::LambdaLiteral) (: property-level hasAnnotation() resolves simple names only :) and not(pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('Value')) and (pmd-kotlin:typeIs('kotlin.Int') or pmd-kotlin:typeIs('kotlin.Long') or pmd-kotlin:typeIs('java.lang.Integer') or pmd-kotlin:typeIs('java.lang.Long')) and ( matches(lower-case(VariableDeclaration/@Identifier), '.*(timeout|time_out|durationout|duration_out|timetolive|time_to_live).*') or (contains(lower-case(VariableDeclaration/@Identifier), 'max') and contains(lower-case(VariableDeclaration/@Identifier), 'route')) ) and .//T-IntegerLiteral ]

rule.name: HttpClientImproperConnectionTimeouts
rule.message: ApacheHttpClient RequestConfig connectionRequestTimeout and connectTimeout have values which are typically too high.
rule.description: Problem: connectionRequestTimeout and connectTimeout above roughly 500 milliseconds often indicate confused units or overly slow fail-fast behaviour. Solution: keep these connection establishment timeouts small and explicit. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseCloseableForHttpClient
rule.message: HttpClient is used instead of ClosableHttpClient.
rule.description: Problem: if HttpClient connections are not closed properly, resources are not released. Solution: use a closeable client in a use block, or hand it to HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PostfixUnaryExpression[ (pmd-kotlin:typeIs('org.apache.http.client.HttpClient') or pmd-kotlin:typeIs('org.apache.http.impl.client.CloseableHttpClient')) (: isWithin pattern :) and ancestor::FunctionBody and not(ancestor-or-self::PostfixUnaryExpression[PostfixUnarySuffix/NavigationSuffix/SimpleIdentifier/*/@Text='use']) and not(ancestor::FunctionBody[.//PrimaryExpression[SimpleIdentifier/*/@Text='HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory']]) ]

rule.name: AvoidUnclearHttpRouteSecurity
rule.message: Avoid unclear HttpRoute security configuration.
rule.description: Problem: HttpRoute constructors with only host or host plus local address leave secure routing intent unclear. Solution: use a constructor that explicitly sets the secure flag. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AvoidDiscardingHttpClientConfig
rule.message: Avoid discarding the HttpClient configuration passed to HttpComponentsClientHttpRequestFactory.
rule.description: Problem: replacing a constructor supplied HttpClient discards configuration already attached to the request factory. Solution: either configure the client before construction or use the no arg constructor before calling setHttpClient. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: HttpClientBuilderPoolSettingsIgnored
rule.message: HttpClient builder is used with a ConnectionManager and MaxConn settings on the client are ignored. Remove them.
rule.description: Problem: when setConnectionManager is used, pool settings must be configured on that connection manager. Client level setMaxConnTotal and setMaxConnPerRoute calls are ignored. Solution: either configure the pool sizes on the connection manager or omit setConnectionManager and configure the client builder directly. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AxualProducerCreatedForEachMethodCall
rule.message: An Axual (Kafka) producer is created for each method call, which is expensive and takes resources.
rule.description: Problem: each Producer takes threads and memory. If you create it in each method call, and call this frequently, it can cause unnecessary resource usage and even OutOfMemoryError. Solution: share Axual Producer instances as class-level properties or Spring beans. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //PropertyDeclaration[ (: isWithin pattern :) ancestor::FunctionBody and not(ancestor::FunctionBody/ancestor-or-self::LambdaLiteral) and pmd-kotlin:typeIs('io.axual.client.producer.Producer') and not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration')]) ]

rule.name: AvoidClientHttpRequestFactorySupplier
rule.message: Avoid ClientHttpRequestFactorySupplier; create a request factory explicitly.
rule.description: Problem: ClientHttpRequestFactorySupplier hides request factory details and can make tuning harder. Solution: create the request factory explicitly and configure the underlying HTTP client directly. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: HttpInterceptorNotReleasingOnException
rule.message: Close ClientHttpResponse before throwing from an interceptor validation path.
rule.description: Problem: throwing from a ClientHttpRequestInterceptor validation path without closing the response can leak resources. Solution: close the ClientHttpResponse explicitly, or use response.use { ... }. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: SetQueueCapacityForTaskExecutor
rule.message: Configure the queue capacity for the ThreadPoolTaskExecutor.
rule.description: The org.springframework.scheduling.concurrent.ThreadPoolTaskExecutor queue capacity is not configured. Problem: It has a default queue capacity which is unlimited which can lead to an out of memory situation. Solution: Call setQueueCapacity (or set queueCapacity property), for instance with a value equal to CorePoolSize. Note that the pool will only grow beyond CorePoolSize up to MaxPoolSize when the queue is full. (jpinpoint-rules)
